functionDeclarations.name: manage_task
functionDeclarations.description: Manage the background tasks of this conversation: 'list' the running tasks, check a task's 'status' and recent log output, 'send_input' to a running task, or 'kill' one. Refer to tasks by the TaskId that 'list' reports; keep task references human-readable when talking to the user.

Action.description: 'list' reports the running tasks; the other actions operate on the task named in TaskId.

Input.description: Input to deliver to the task. Required for 'send_input'.

TaskId.description: Task to manage, as reported by 'list'. Required for 'kill', 'status' and 'send_input'.
